Dairow Vin is a tiefling who can be found Act Three.

Involvement

Dairow Vin can be found unconscious in the Lower City Sewers at X: -155 Y: 846, surrounded by empty  Potion of Sleep bottles. He has the condition  Impenetrable slumber, thus it is impossible to wake him up.[1]

History

Dairow and his husband fled Elturel for a better life. At some point they separated, Dairow taking work with the Guild, and his husband travelling with a group of refugees.[2]

After losing contact with his husband, Dairow contacted guildmaster  Nine-Fingers Keene to try and find information on his whereabouts. The Guild were able to track the latest refugees he was travelling with, but after crossing paths with the Absolute's forces, the entire group went missing without a trace.[2]

Grieving the loss and probable death of his husband, Dairow consumed a large quantity of  Potions of Sleep, falling into an impenetrable slumber in the city sewers.

Dairow's husband is speculated to be the brother of the dead refugee  Garrett, whose corpse can be found by the cliffside in Rivington. Information supporting this assertion can be learned by using  Speak with Dead Dairow through which it is revealed that he fled from the Absolute's army with his brother. Additional evidence includes the  Our Offer Remains Open note on Dairow Vin's body, which shows his husband was also a refugee. Also on the refugee's body is the  Gemless Ring which, when combined with the  Ringless Gem held by  Ferg Drogher, creates a  Tarnished Ring. If Garrett is asked about the ring using Speak with Dead, he answers that the ring belonged to his brother - who died on the road. Finally, if pickpocketing or killing Dairow Vin, a similar tarnished ring can be found. All of these details lend credence to the theory that Garrett’s brother was Dairow’s husband, and the Tarnished Rings were their wedding bands.
